title: Groups I-1 and R-1.
officialText:
Group I-1 and R-1 dwelling units or sleeping units in accordance with Table
907.5.2.3.3 shall be provided with a visible alarm notification appliance, activated by both the in-room smoke
detector and the building fire alarm system.
TABLE 907.5.2.3.3
VISIBLE ALARMS
NUMBER OF UNITS WITH
UNITS VISIBLE ALARMS
6 to 25 2
26 to 50 4
51 to 75 7
76 to 100 9
101 to 150 12
151 to 200 14
201 to 300 17
301 to 400 20
401 to 500 22
501 to 1,000 5% of total
1,001 and over 50 plus 3 for each 100 over 1,000
